Locations.Text: Stardew Valley Expanded widens the valley with new farms, vineyards, magical routes, dangerous regions beyond ordinary Pelican Town life.

BlueMoonVineyard.Name: Blue Moon Vineyard
BlueMoonVineyard.Description: Sophia's home and working vineyard near Pelican Town; grape trellises, kegs, shipments, grief, sewing, quiet routines.

CindersapForest.Name: Cindersap Forest
CindersapForest.Description: In SVE, wider, busier forest; still Marnie's Ranch, Leah's cottage, Wizard's Tower; also routes toward Fairhaven Farm, Aurora Vineyard, West Cindersap, stranger forest magic.

FairhavenFarm.Name: Fairhaven Farm
FairhavenFarm.Description: Andy's isolated Cindersap Forest farm; stubborn independence, Joja habits, Yoba faith, foraging routes, lonely evenings.

AuroraVineyard.Name: Aurora Vineyard
AuroraVineyard.Description: Abandoned vineyard tied to Junimos and Apples; old, magical, half-remembered, unlike a normal commercial farm.

Grampleton.Name: Grampleton
Grampleton.Description: Grampleton and its fields suggest a larger settled region east of Pelican Town; villagers may treat it as the nearest bigger neighbor, reachable but outside daily farm-town life.

Highlands.Name: Highlands
Highlands.Description: Expanded adventure region tied to Lance and late-game exploration; portray as remote, dangerous, far from normal valley errands.

Villagers.Text: SVE residents and side characters: public context only; deeper personality and relationship detail belongs in each NPC biography.

Alesia.Name: Alesia
Alesia.Description: She's linked to Castle Village and wider adventuring beyond Pelican Town; seasoned, capable, more at home around danger than ordinary town life.

Andy.Name: Andy
Andy.Description: Lonely, stubborn Fairhaven Farm owner in Cindersap Forest; Joja supporter, farmer, forager, saloon visitor, Yoba reader; often clashes with local leaders.

Apples.Name: Apples
Apples.Description: Junimo tied to Aurora Vineyard and valley magic; their presence: innocent, strange, rooted in forest magic, apart from ordinary town gossip.

Camilla.Name: Camilla
Camilla.Description: Powerful witch figure linked to magic far beyond Pelican Town; she's elegant, dangerous, knowledgeable, only partly engaged in village life.

Claire.Name: Claire
Claire.Description: She lives outside Pelican Town; bus commute to JojaMart or later the movie theater. Quiet, reserved, dreams beyond retail; enjoys reading, dancing, films, birds.

Gunther.Name: Gunther
Gunther.Description: SVE museum and library curator, fuller town resident; he's scholarly, patient, devoted to rebuilding the valley's historical collection.

Hank.Name: Hank
Hank.Description: SVE side resident in Pelican Town's expanded social web; references modest unless current context supplies firmer facts.

Henchman.Name: Henchman
Henchman.Description: Tied to Witch's Swamp and magical errands; guarded supernatural gatekeeper, unlike a regular townsperson.

Isaac.Name: Isaac
Isaac.Description: Remote SVE adventurer tied to dangerous regions beyond the valley; he's practical, hardened, more military adventurer than small-town neighbor.

Jadu.Name: Jadu
Jadu.Description: SVE magical, distant-world character; he's an otherworldly contact, not a normal Pelican Town resident unless context says otherwise.

Jolyne.Name: Jolyne
Jolyne.Description: She belongs to SVE's Castle Village side, a martial, far-reaching network beyond valley farm-town routines.

Lance.Name: Lance
Lance.Description: Marriage candidate; he's a disciplined, capable adventurer tied to First Slash guild, Ginger Island, dangerous expeditions; worldlier than most villagers.

Marlon.Name: Marlon
Marlon.Description: Fuller SVE resident, Adventurer's Guild leader; old scars, monster knowledge, ties to magic, Marnie, Krobus, and wider dangers around the valley.

Martin.Name: Martin
Martin.Description: Polite countryside teenager working at JojaMart or the movie theater; visits museum library; he's hopeful, connected online, lonely outside work.

Morgan.Name: Morgan
Morgan.Description: Young magic student tied to the Wizard; they're curious, developing, still learning the valley's magical rules.

Morris.Name: Morris
Morris.Description: More personally present SVE JojaMart manager; ambitious, corporate, image-conscious, he can be more complex than a simple villain.

Olivia.Name: Olivia
Olivia.Description: Olivia Jenkins: wealthy retiree beside Pierre's with her son Victor; past Joja ties and stock-market success; enjoys wine, refined food, painting, yoga, social status.

Peaches.Name: Peaches
Peaches.Description: Non-giftable SVE character tied to expanded magic; references light and context-dependent.

Scarlett.Name: Scarlett
Scarlett.Description: Sophia's close friend and key link beyond the vineyard; she brings steadiness, friendship, emotional support to Sophia's circle.

Sophia.Name: Sophia
Sophia.Description: Blue Moon Vineyard owner and worker; shy, keeps to herself, enjoys anime, manga, cosplay, sewing; grief beneath a soft, anxious manner.

Susan.Name: Susan
Susan.Description: She lives at Emerald Farm; farmer linked to town once railroad area opens, with a practical, rural view of the valley's expanded north.

Treyvon.Name: Treyvon
Treyvon.Description: SVE's wider expanded-world side cast; avoid over-specific claims unless current context supplies them.

Victor.Name: Victor
Victor.Description: Victor Jenkins: lives with Olivia after graduating top of his engineering class; thoughtful, educated, uncertain of his future; often near books, museum, park, sea.
